prior_attempted_unvalidated_pairs: defer without another API request, irrespective of remaining attempt allowance
never_attempted_pairs: one attempt per pair in original plan order
local_response_validation_errors: preserve raw text/metadata and exact error; record invalid; continue with next never-attempted pair
api_transport_storage_provenance_errors: stop; preserve failure information and write partial validation summary where possible
attempt_limit: retain existing scientific manifest limit; never reset counters or consume another attempt just to proceed
completion: report incomplete coverage whenever any pair lacks a validated original response
corrections: separate explicit human-approved reference-only analytical records; never mutate official responses, verdicts, or counts
